name: Fathom Analytics
desc: Privacy-focused website analytics. Query your site traffic, manage sites and events, and generate custom reports.

actions.name: list_sites
actions.description: Return a list of all sites this API key has access to.

actions.name: get_site
actions.description: Retrieve details for a specific site by its ID.

actions.name: create_event
actions.description: Create a custom event (goal) for a specific site.

actions.name: list_events
actions.description: List all custom events (goals) for a specific site.

actions.name: get_aggregation
actions.description: Generate a custom analytics aggregation report. Supports flexible grouping, filtering, and date ranges.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
